items.t: Front wheel hub can shift out of the steering knuckle
items.job: Reseat front bearings and install retainer brackets
items.note: Volvo's book time is 0.9 hour per side for the retainer. If the hub or knuckle is damaged, a new hub kit adds about $120–$310 per side.

items.t: Clogged PCV oil trap causes whistling and oil leaks
items.job: Replace PCV oil trap (breather box) and hoses
items.note: The intake manifold usually has to come off. C30 owners report paying about $500–$800.

items.t: Timing belt or idler pulley failure can wreck the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, idler pulley and water pump
items.note: Doing the water pump and accessory belt at the same time saves labor. C30 owners report paying about $800–$2,000.

items.t: Front camshaft seal oil leak
items.note: Timing belt must come off; pairing it with a belt change saves money. One owner paid $1,160.

items.t: Coolant expansion tank cracks and leaks
Turbo boost control valve failure
items.job: Replace turbo boost control solenoid valve
items.note: Owners report $100 with an aftermarket valve.

items.t: Fuel pressure sensor failure
items.note: Owners report $340 for this job.

items.t: Reduced engine power warning from accelerator pedal or throttle faults
items.job: Replace accelerator pedal sensor or throttle body
items.note: A loose connector or wiring repair costs much less than a new throttle body.

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs
items.note: Price depends on whether one coil or all five are replaced.

items.t: Electric radiator fan fails
items.note: Owners report $250–$850.

items.t: Check engine light from failed EVAP leak detection pump
items.note: One owner paid $450.

items.t: Worn engine mounts cause vibration
Harsh or jerky automatic shifts
items.job: Update software and adaptation, or replace valve body
items.note: Software and adaptation cost the least. One owner paid $1,575 for a valve body and torque converter. A full transmission replacement costs much more.

items.t: Clutch or dual-mass flywheel wear on manual cars
items.job: Replace clutch kit (and flywheel if needed)
items.note: One owner paid $1,800 for a clutch, slave cylinder and pressure plate. A new flywheel raises the cost.

items.t: Torn CV boots and worn front axles
items.note: Replacing just a torn boot is cheaper if the joint is still good.

items.t: Noisy wheel bearings
items.job: Replace wheel bearing and hub assembly
items.note: Price is per wheel.

items.t: Worn struts and strut mounts
items.note: Includes an alignment. Owners report $880–$1,300.

items.t: Worn sway bar links and bushings
items.note: Owners report $100–$300.

items.t: Worn control arm bushings
items.note: Owners report $400–$900 for this work.

items.t: Broken front coil springs
Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
items.job: Clear or reattach sunroof drain tubes
items.note: Owners report $95–$300; replacing all drain tubes can cost more.

items.t: Windshield seal leaks water into the cabin
items.note: Resealing costs less than a new windshield.

items.t: A/C compressor or clutch failure
items.note: A clutch-only or valve repair costs less. One owner paid $2,500 for a compressor and condenser.

items.t: Alternator failure
Battery drains overnight from the satellite radio receiver
items.job: Update or replace satellite radio receiver (RDAR)
items.note: Owners report $220 for a software fix. A battery damaged by repeated drains may also need replacing.

items.t: Steering lock fault stops the car from starting
items.job: Replace and program steering column lock
items.note: Dealer programming adds a fee.

items.t: Airbag light from passenger seat sensor or wiring
items.job: Repair seat wiring or replace passenger weight sensor
items.note: Owners report $150 for a wiring repair and about $450 for sensor wiring.

items.t: Xenon headlight bulb or ballast failure
items.note: Owners report $110–$245; a ballast costs more.

items.t: Rear brake caliper or parking brake sticks
items.note: One owner paid $560 for a caliper and pads.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer if the recall work was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Manual gearshift lever stud can come loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair gearshift lever stud (recall 10V255)
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer if the recall work was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Dealer portable GPS battery can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer if the recall work was never done. Check your VIN.
